scripts.dev: npm run sync && concurrently -n server,guest,admin -c blue,green,magenta --kill-others --success first "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:guest" "npm:dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run sync && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w guest && npm run build -w admin
scripts.test: npm run sync && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w guest && npm run test -w admin
